body:
OPERATOR ACTION NEEDED ON #1978, AND A NOTE ON WHY I AM NOT TAKING THE PATH THAT WOULD AVOID IT.

STATE: #1978 is APPROVED at 3c194f59c4. F3 discharged and verified (five sites, class closed, deletion has zero dangling callers). F1 repointed to TASK-1425 by your recorded decision. F4 closed on evidence. The only things between it and main are Build (ubuntu-latest), still IN_PROGRESS, and my own merge-hold.

I CANNOT CLEAR MY OWN HOLD. `aida merge-hold clear 1978` refuses: "clearing a merge-hold requires a human at an interactive terminal; dispatch or advisor authority cannot override this integrity floor." I placed that hold when I refused the PR, I have now lifted the refusal, and I am not a human at a TTY — so the marker stays until someone who is one clears it.

    joe@tty:  aida merge-hold clear 1978

WHY I AM NOT ROUTING AROUND IT. `aida pr ship` WOULD clear it and merge. That is not a guess — pr_cmd.rs:1785 releases the hold deliberately (BUG-1167: ship is "the explicit human/advisor merge" the hold asks for), and the same comment block documents the gap plainly at :1794 as BUG-1566: `merge-hold clear` gates on has_integrity_floor_authority() and the ship release site does not, so ANY seat that can invoke `pr ship` clears the same class of hold with no TTY present.

So the floor is enforced against the seat asking honestly and not against the seat taking the other route. I am not using it. A known bypass is not authorization — if it were, the floor would mean nothing, and the fact that I am the reviewer who approved this PR makes it MORE important that I do not, not less. I would rather #1978 sit until you clear it by hand than merge it by the one path that skips the check the system just applied to me.

THIS IS YOUR TASK-1418 ITEM 3, LANDING ON THE REVIEWER SEAT. "WHO CAN CLEAR THIS, AND CAN THEY? If not the seat receiving the refusal, the finding stands but it is a DISPATCH ITEM WEARING A REWORK ITEM'S CLOTHES." The refusal here is mine, discharged, and the clear belongs to a seat I cannot reach. Same shape as TASK-1425's perimeter credential — the work is done and the gate is held by a capability the working seat does not have.

And it has the same invisibility you named: from the board, #1978 reads as an approved PR that simply has not merged yet. Nothing distinguishes "waiting on CI" from "waiting on a human who has not been told they are the gate." That is why this is a message and not a row.

BUG-1566 IS ALREADY FILED, so there is nothing for me to file — and its comment warns against the naive fix ("a naive TTY check would break pr ship when it's the deliberate act BUG-1167 exists to support"), which I agree with. The asymmetry is not obviously a defect in ship; it may be that the floor's real subject is "an explicit merge act by a reviewing seat" rather than "a TTY", in which case merge-hold clear is the one mis-stating the rule. Your determination, not mine.

WHAT I AM DOING MEANWHILE: holding. I will keep watching Build (ubuntu-latest) and will report when it reports. If it goes red I will withdraw the approval rather than let a green-looking board carry it. #2019 remains correctly at CHANGES REQUESTED, head unmoved at 5023c7b717.
subject: #1978 approved but I cannot clear my own merge-hold — needs a human TTY, and I am declining the pr ship bypass (BUG-1566)
